scientific.integrity: The proof separates the fixed-time triangular weak law from the uniform-in-time martingale estimate. The former uses uniform integrability rather than an unavailable second moment, while the latter explicitly requires only the \(2p-2\)-moment. No finite simulation is used as evidence for the asymptotic theorem.
scientific.limitations: The theorem assumes fully independent coordinates and does not show that the moment order \(\max\{2,2p-2\}\) is optimal. The \(p=2\) specialization is prior work.

title: Lower moment thresholds for independent-coordinate high-dimensional random walks
